data.name: Imaanah
data.gender_notes: Imaanah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Imaanah is a beautiful Arabic name derived from the word 'Emanah' which means 'Faith', 'Belief', or 'Trust'. In Islamic tradition, Imaanah is considered a vital aspect of one's spiritual journey. It is the inner conviction that helps one remain steadfast in their beliefs and actions, keeping them connected to Allah. The name Imaanah carries the meaning “Faith, belief” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Imaanah usually hope their child will grow to embody faith, belief and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of inner conviction and unwavering faith in Allah.
data.etymology: Imaanah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Faith, belief.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Imaanah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
